label: bounded evidence, not proof

goldbach_even.literature: Published computations report verification far beyond this range (e.g. Oliveira e Silva, Herzog & Pardi, to 4·10^18).

collatz_descent.literature: Published computations report verification far beyond this range (e.g. Barina, to 2^68).

legendre_square_gap.literature: Implied far beyond this range by published prime-gap computations; open in general.

lehmer_totient.literature: Published work rules out small counterexamples (e.g. Cohen & Hagis: any counterexample has many prime factors); open in general.

erdos_straus.literature: Published computer searches reach far beyond this range; open in general.

twin_primes_hl.literature: Asymptotic conjecture; finite counts can only be consistent or inconsistent with it, never decide it.

note: Frontier evidence is bounded evidence, not proof; it is never scored as a proof.
